iterations.title: First complete model and five-view review
iterations.notes: Recognizable clothing and stance, but scalp intersections, terraced contours, covered neckline and overbright skin prevent a credible likeness. Target not reached.

iterations.title: Continuous contours and clean scalp coverage
iterations.notes: Terraced body contours and scalp holes are corrected. The neckline is open and shading is cleaner. Shoulder width, wide-eyed expression, hair shape and detached-looking straps still need refinement.

iterations.title: Proportion and expression correction
iterations.notes: Shoulders are narrower, hands no longer protrude in front, the scalp is rounded and irises are bounded by eyelids. The face remains stylized; hair clumps, rigid backpack and floating strap hardware still need work.

iterations.title: Hair, bag, hand pose and shoe refinement
iterations.notes: The backpack and clasped-hand composition are better, but the forearm loft flattened under the new pose. Collar-band intersections and the lower lip need correction. These regressions are explicitly retained in the review record.
